name: Forced displacement
summary: UN counts up to 50,000 fleeing Ethiopia's Moyale clashes into Kenya; an NGO estimate of 700,000 displaced is unconfirmed
state: UNHCR said up to 50,000 people crossed from Ethiopia into Kenya after Moyale clashes from 22 Oct (Al Jazeera, 17 Nov), and Islamic Relief estimates nearly 700,000 displaced by the conflict (Addis Standard), a figure not yet confirmed by UNHCR or IOM. UNHCR said in Nov that nearly 64,000 people have fled Nigeria into Niger this year (UN News). No UN-confirmed event reaches 500,000 in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: People in southern Ethiopia, northern Kenya and Niger's border areas face displacement and shortages of food, water and shelter.
rubric_hit: No new event confirmed by UNHCR or IOM displacing over 500,000 in a month (Normal); Moyale NGO estimate under review
